# Platformator coding guidance

C++20 engine: public API in include/platformator, private implementation in src, tests in tests, CMake support in cmake, standalone game in examples/mario. SDL3, Eigen 5, oneTBB and JSON dependencies are bundled. CMake/Ninja replaces old make/SDL2 instructions.

Configure before building: `cmake --preset cleanup-debug`; `cmake --build --preset cleanup-debug --parallel 4`; `ctest --test-dir bin/cleanup-debug --output-on-failure -E package_smoke`. Test registration excludes dependency suites. Public headers compile independently; source and installed consumers link Platformator::platformator. See README and docs/CPP_API_MIGRATION.md.

Runtime owns one flat object collection. Handles contain runtime serial, generation and slot; serialized IDs are scene-local. Structural requests reconcile at named barriers. Every behavior resolves references immediately before its first start, using the published scene, regardless of how it was created. Inactive behaviors defer both operations. Attached behaviors wait in a pending collection and join runnable dispatch after one resolve/start attempt, including logged initialization failures; ordinary callbacks do not check a per-behavior started flag. Startup logs initialization exceptions per behavior and keeps attempted behaviors runnable; attempts are not retried automatically. Queue each ScriptComponent once for startup and keep just two owning component lists: pending and runnable. Iterate each queued script's pending vector directly, then transfer its attempted prefix to runnable behaviors and clear the processed pending entries; eligible additions during startup can initialize in the same pass. Additions from later phases wait for the next startup pass. Failed initialization leaves the behavior owned for ordinary callbacks and normal teardown. A resolver exception skips start for that attempt. getBehavior/serialization/teardown inspect both lists; getBehaviors returns runnable entries and getPendingBehaviors returns pending entries. Graph/component preparation errors preserve the old scene; behavior startup errors do not roll back a committed scene. Logical retirement suppresses callbacks immediately; destruction callbacks run read-only before freeing attached allocations. Pass ReferenceResolver explicitly; do not add a separate scene-loading behavior-resolution path. Preserve resource lifetimes through final users.

Physics uses an incremental spatial grid, pair-local parallel manifolds, canonical serial support reduction, persistent contact/subscription/body indexes, cached world transforms and parent-first publication after worker integration. Interactive run uses fixed 1/120 steps; explicit host ticks use supplied positive dt. Keep existing geometry/sleep/support assertions meaningful.

Every nonempty asset path uses the literal assets/ prefix and resolves beneath RuntimeOptions.assetRoot. Preserve filename case; normalize separators. Reject bare/scene-relative/animation-relative paths, absolute asset filenames, parent traversal and symlink escapes. Do not reintroduce directory-aware resolvers or heuristic asset-root searching. Host asset-root configuration and scene-opening filesystem paths are separate APIs.

Write simple code. Validate input/public misuse at boundaries and assert established internal invariants. Do not add null checks everywhere, silent exception handling, full-scene safety sweeps, active-list snapshots, or hot-path deduplication by linear search. Use indexed membership, coalesced dirty queues and reusable scratch capacity. When a design seems inefficient, implement the feasible better design. Only unavoidable retained inefficiency gets a local `EFFICIENCY:` comment explaining cost/frequency, reason, better design and concrete prerequisites. Tests can use expensive independent oracles.

Run relevant tests and required broader checks after meaningful changes. ASan/UBSan instrument dependencies; TSan must also use instrumented TBB. Work probes are opt-in and excluded from performance captures. Benchmarks use Release without debug/probe/sanitizer instrumentation, five independent processes, explicit seed/workers/dt and schema-v2 raw samples/manifests. Keep expensive invariant validation separate from timing. Do not relabel historical partial frame metrics or claim unsupported cross-engine equivalence. Preserve benchmark baselines and the unratified constitution template.
